text:
maya: Quick alignment: product wants a minimal, auditable invoke envelope for Q2. Keep v1 small.
jamal: Agree. v1 = sync JSON envelope, strict JSON Schema for tool manifests, and telemetry hooks. No webhooks in GA.
kevin: Security: require response signature when tool executes outside our trust domain; enforce content_type for non-JSON.
nora: Support needs trace_id and machine error codes so we can route tickets.
deploy-bot: Canary rule: 14-day canary; contract tests must be green.
maya: Proposed v1 envelope (compact): {"envelope_version":"1","call_id":"<string>","tool":"<string>","input":"<any>","result":{"status":"ok|error","output":"<any>","error_code":"<string|null>"},"telemetry":{"trace_id":"<string>","tokens":"<int>"},"signature":"<string|null>"}
jamal: Lock decisions: envelope_version field, closed status enum, error taxonomy classes: validation, execution, auth, resource.
kevin: Action: I'll write the signature + content policy. Jamal: please ship schema PR by Thu. Maya: draft launch checklist and partner canary list. Reconvene Friday for sign-off. :thumbsup:
